en.name: Nougat
en.summary: Sealed and kept cool and dry, a bar of nougat keeps about 12 months to its printed date, and roughly 1 month once opened. No agency publishes a figure for nougat, so those numbers are read across from marshmallows — the other aerated sugar-and-egg-white confection. The fridge is the one place it should not go.
en.pantry: Cool, dark and dry, sealed, about 12 months from purchase and to the printed date. Nougat is a supersaturated sugar and honey syrup aerated with egg white and loaded with nuts: the sugar binds the water and there is very little left for anything to grow in. Its enemy is humidity, not bacteria. Nougat is strongly hygroscopic, and a bar left open in a damp kitchen goes sticky, then weeps syrup, then sets into a solid slab. Re-wrap it airtight the moment you open it, edible rice paper and all, and count on about 1 month.
en.fridge: Avoid it. A fridge is humid, and taking cold nougat out into a warm room condenses water straight onto the surface — which is exactly what ruins it. There is no refrigerated timeline for nougat and there should not be one: cool and dry beats cold and damp every time. If your kitchen is hot, find the coolest dry cupboard rather than the fridge.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline exists for nougat, and freezing runs into the same condensation problem as the fridge, only worse. The cupboard figure already covers a year, which is longer than most bars survive in a household. If you must freeze a large slab, wrap it airtight in layers and let it return to room temperature completely sealed before you unwrap it.
en.thawing: Not normally applicable. If nougat has been chilled or frozen, let it come fully back to room temperature inside its wrapping before opening, or condensation will make it tacky.
spoilage: A sticky, weeping surface, or a whole bar set into one solid slab — humidity damage.
A bitter, crayon-like aftertaste from the almonds, pistachios or hazelnuts going rancid.
A stale, cardboard smell instead of honey and toasted nuts.
Mould, which is rare and means the wrapper let in real moisture.
tips: The edible rice paper stops nougat sticking; it is not a moisture barrier, so re-wrap the bar.
Keep it away from the hob and the steam of a kettle.
Cut a hard bar with a heavy knife warmed under hot water and dried.
Buy in small bars rather than one large slab if you eat it occasionally.

faq.a: About 12 months sealed in a cool, dry cupboard, and roughly 1 month once opened. These figures are read across from marshmallows; no agency publishes one for nougat.

faq.q: Should nougat be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: No. The fridge is humid, and condensation on the way out is the main thing that ruins nougat. A cool, dry cupboard is correct.

faq.q: How can you tell if nougat has gone bad?
faq.a: Taste it. A bitter, crayon-like note means the nuts have gone rancid. A sticky, weeping surface is humidity damage rather than spoilage, but the texture will not come back.

zh.name: 牛軋糖
zh.summary: 密封、放在陰涼乾燥處，一條牛軋糖大約可以放 12 個月、以包裝標示日期為準，開封後大約 1 個月。沒有機關為牛軋糖公布數字，所以這些是比照棉花糖來看的——同樣是打發的糖與蛋白做成的糖果。冰箱則是它唯一不該去的地方。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起約 12 個月，並以包裝日期為準。牛軋糖是過飽和的糖與蜂蜜糖漿用蛋白打發、再塞滿堅果的東西：糖把水綁住，能讓東西生長的水所剩無幾。它的敵人是濕度，不是細菌。牛軋糖非常會吸濕，開封後丟在潮濕的廚房裡，先是發黏，接著滲糖水，最後黏結成一整塊硬板。一開封就連糯米紙一起重新密封包好，並抓大約 1 個月。
zh.fridge: 別冰。冰箱裡是潮濕的，冰過的牛軋糖拿到溫暖的房間，水氣會直接凝結在表面——而那正是毀掉它的原因。牛軋糖沒有冷藏的期限數據，也不該有：陰涼乾燥永遠贏過又冷又濕。廚房太熱的話，請找最涼的乾燥櫃子，而不是冰箱。
zh.freezer: 牛軋糖沒有冷凍的期限數據，而冷凍會遇到和冷藏一樣的結露問題，只會更嚴重。櫥櫃的數字已經涵蓋一年，比多數人家裡一條糖能撐的時間還久。真的要凍一大塊，請層層密封包好，並且維持完全密封回到室溫再拆開。
zh.thawing: 一般用不到。若冰過或凍過，請連著包裝完全回到室溫再打開，否則結露會讓表面發黏。
spoilage: 表面發黏、滲出糖液，或整條黏結成一塊硬板——這是受潮。
杏仁、開心果或榛果油耗後那股苦苦的蠟筆味。
聞起來是陳味、紙板味，而不是蜂蜜和烘香堅果。
發霉——很少見，出現就代表包裝真的讓水氣進去了。
tips: 糯米紙是防沾黏用的，不是防潮層，所以整條還是要重新包好。
遠離爐台，也遠離熱水壺的蒸氣。
太硬的話，用熱水燙過擦乾的厚刀來切。
偶爾才吃的話，買小條裝，不要買一大塊。

faq.a: 密封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃約 12 個月，開封後大約 1 個月。這些數字是比照棉花糖而來，沒有機關公布牛軋糖的期限。
不要。冰箱潮濕，拿出來的結露正是毀掉牛軋糖的主因。陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃才對。
嚐一下。出現苦苦的蠟筆味，代表堅果已經油耗。表面發黏滲水則是受潮而不是腐敗，但口感回不來了。
